desc: Formalize reachability: ball at v reaches X iff v is on X's cycle in the respective permutation (P for red, Q for blue); otherwise answer -1.
Determine operated set: chain = all boxes on X's cycle at distance ≤ d_max (contiguous suffix of forward walk from P_X / Q_X), since balls cascade through every intermediate box.

Handle chain reactions/ordering: each color requires its chain operated in decreasing-distance order; minimum operations = shortest common supersequence of the two chains = |R| + |B| − |LCS|; LCS via LIS (chains have distinct elements). Verified on all 4 samples (4, 0, -1, 8).
Feasibility check: any ball starting off X's cycle in its color's permutation ⇒ -1; X is never operated (chain excludes X automatically since d_max ≤ L−1).
Implement solve() in Python: O(N) cycle walks with position maps, O(N log N) LIS; read stdin, print answer.
Verify edge cases in code: no balls (0), all balls at X (0), self-loop at X (P_X=X with other balls of that color ⇒ -1), N=2 minimal cases, walk termination guaranteed since P,Q are permutations.
